patient_identity.statement: SMS324 is the 18-year-old male described in the paper; subject age/sex match.

genotype.statement: Paper reports c.3103delC in SMS324 and shows normal/deleted alleles. Exact newer transcript/protein and hg38 normalization in packet are not independently established by this 2010 report.
limitations: Modern HGVS/genomic normalization not reported.

segregation.statement: No parental segregation testing or inheritance result is reported for this patient.
limitations: Parental origin/de novo status unknown.

phase.statement: Single reported RAI1 variant; two-variant cis/trans phase is inapplicable. Parental origin not established.
limitations: Not a measured phase result.

causal_confidence.statement: Authors attribute SMS features to the RAI1 frameshift; predicted loss of function is not a patient functional measurement. FLCN isoform-dependent rs3744124 contribution to pneumothoraces explicitly remains uncertain.
limitations: Case-report attribution, not independent clinical validation; no formal new ACMG classification.

phenotype_completeness.statement: Not an exhaustive phenotype record. Severe asthma, rage/anxiety/obsessional behaviour, brachydactyly and uncertain FLCN contribution are omitted. Neonatal reflux/failure to thrive and head-banging at age 3 are explicitly described.
limitations: Preserve source ambiguities and alternate patient identity; signature sharing does not equate the patients.

assessment.statement: Paper reports c.3103delC in SMS324 and shows normal/deleted alleles. Exact newer transcript/protein and hg38 normalization in packet are not independently established by this 2010 report.
limitations: Modern HGVS/genomic normalization not reported.
